title: Sparse-autoencoder feature pipeline (train, analyse, explain, steer)
boundary_note: Safety framing = interpretability for alignment auditing (finding deception features with SAEs). Transcripts are synthetic word lists; no harmful content.

rubric.desc: config: unknown sections or keys raise ValueError instead of being silently dropped (README)
config: load_config never mutates the module-level DEFAULTS (deep_merge merged in place, so overrides leaked into later loads)
config: --set overrides take precedence over the config file (file was merged last)
synth.generate is deterministic for a seed (label shuffle used the global numpy RNG)
store.read returns the right rows inside a shard (np.fromfile offset is in bytes, not elements)
store reads float16 shards with the dtype recorded in the index (was hard-coded float32)
data_hash fingerprints the activation values, not just shard names/shapes, so re-extracted data gets a new hash
compute_norm_scale uses the mean squared norm over all tokens (mean of chunk means was biased by the partial last chunk)
shuffled iter_batches yields the final partial batch unless drop_last (every token exactly once)
store.locate maps the first token of a transcript to (seq, 0) (searchsorted side off by one)
normalize_decoder rescales each latent's decoder ROW to unit norm (normalised columns: wrong axis)
forward(x) == decode(encode(x)); b_dec was subtracted twice
TopK keeps exactly k latents under ties, lower index first (threshold >= kth kept all ties)
TopK applies ReLU after selection (negative selected pre-activations were kept)
gradient of b_dec includes its path through the encoder input (finite-difference check)
gradient of W_enc uses the centred input x - b_dec (finite-difference check)
SparseAutoencoder.copy() is independent of later in-place updates (was a shallow copy)
Adam second-moment bias correction uses beta2 (used beta1: first steps ~10x too large)
lr warmup is lr*(s+1)/warmup for 0-based step s (step 0 had lr 0)
clip_grad_norm clips by the joint global norm, not per tensor
Adam.load_state_dict implemented (resume reproduces the next step)
dead-latent window counted in optimiser steps, not tokens
resampling draws inputs with probability proportional to squared loss (was uniform over the worse half)
resampled encoder columns scaled by 0.2 x mean norm of ALIVE latents' encoder columns
resampling zeroes the Adam moments of the resampled latents (reset_latents was never called)
b_dec initialised to the mean of the NORMALISED activations (cross-module units)
periodic checkpoints are written after decoder renormalisation (unit-norm invariant)
fraction of variance explained uses variance about the mean, not the uncentred sum of squares
L0 counts every strictly positive latent (had a 1e-3 tolerance)
dead fraction is computed over the whole evaluation pass, not averaged per batch
log_softmax / cross_entropy are numerically stable for large logits (max-shift)
loss_recovered = (CE_ablated - CE_recon) / (CE_ablated - CE_clean) (returned the fraction lost)
evaluate_sae divides reconstructions by norm_scale so metrics are in original units
MSE is the mean over tokens of the squared L2 error (was mean over elements)
metrics.mean_max_cosine implemented (signed max cosine per true direction, rows not unit)
example context includes window tokens AFTER the activating token too (right end off by one)
max-activating examples break activation ties by earlier token row
max-activating examples only include tokens where the latent fires
AUROC gives tied scores half credit (average ranks) - ties at 0 are the common case
welch_t uses unpooled sample variances and Welch-Satterthwaite df (was pooled Student t, ddof=0)
Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values are made monotone (cumulative min from the top)
features.density_histogram implemented (log10 bins, clipping, never-firing count)
explanation score / pearson is 0.0 (not nan) when either series is constant
held-out split is by whole transcript (was per token, leaking context)
explanations are proposed only from fit (non-held-out) transcripts (score leakage)
simulation compares tokens and keywords after lower-casing and stripping punctuation
explain.parse_explanation implemented
ablate keeps the SAE reconstruction error: x_s + decode(z') - decode(z)
steering_effect divides patched activations by norm_scale before the probe
run_steering reads the checkpoint's hook, not paths.hook from the config
run_steering measures the behaviour score on POS-transcript tokens only
StatsCache key includes the store data hash (stale stats after data change)
StatsCache returns copies so callers' mutations do not corrupt cached values
StatsCache.save / StatsCache.load implemented with numpy dtype/shape round-trip
fingerprint_checkpoint hashes the weights, not only meta.json
load_checkpoint restores activation and k (TopK SAE came back as ReLU)
load_checkpoint restores norm_scale (read key 'scale' and defaulted to 1.0)
checkpoint.list_checkpoints implemented (step_<n> with meta.json, numeric order)
candidate firing-frequency bounds are inclusive
candidates are filtered on BH-adjusted p-values, not raw p
write_report converts numpy dict keys / scalars / arrays to plain JSON
reports are strict JSON: nan/inf written as null
report.format_markdown implemented
CLI exits 2 with an error message naming the path (no traceback) when the store is missing (DESIGN)
